correctness.rationale: The exact degree-n neighbor count a-x+y yields correct even and odd set-valued update formulas. value.rationale: The complete classification concerns a natural matched pair of dense communities, determines sharp universal transient times and exact fixed and primitive two-orbit populations, and yields a nontrivial parity discontinuity in the asymptotic probability of persistent oscillation: inverse-linear for even clique size and exponential times a polynomial for odd size. The distinction between odd one-step attraction and even no nonperiodic attraction is dynamical, not just enumerative.
